Reranking with top_n parameter to limit results

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\RerankRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\RerankRequest::from_json(json_encode(["documents" => ["Python is a programming language.", "Cats are cute animals.", "Python was created by Guido van Rossum.", "The sun is a star."], "model" => "rerank-v3.5", "query" => "What is Python?", "topN" => 2]));
$apiKey = getenv('API_KEY');
if ($apiKey === false || $apiKey === '') {
    throw new RuntimeException('API_KEY must be set');
}
$client = LiterLlm::createClient($apiKey);
$result = $client->rerank($req);
var_dump($result->getResults());
var_dump($result->getResults()[0]->relevanceScore);
```
